title: Arthritis Support
ayurvedicView: Arthritis involves Vata imbalance with inflammation. Anti-inflammatory herbs and gentle movement help.
remedies: Turmeric and ginger supplements or tea
Warm oil massage with mahanarayana oil
Shallaki (boswellia) extract, if a practitioner advises

icd11.title: Osteoarthritis, unspecified
icd11.note: Closest match for general arthritis support; inflammatory arthritis such as rheumatoid arthritis is coded differently.

seeDoctor: A hot, red, swollen joint, especially with fever
Morning stiffness that lasts more than an hour
Pain that stops you walking or sleeping
